group.name: The Global Institute of Forensic Research
group.description: The Global Institute of Forensic Research, Inc. (GIFR), owned by Multi-Health Systems, Inc., specializes in providing cutting-edge research, training, and software solutions to mental health, correctional, and legal professionals working in both general care and forensic settings around the world. Dedicated to innovation, simplicity, and customer service, our team of international experts develops services and programming to promote evidence-based best practices and improve both compliance and outcomes in assessment, treatment, and monitoring.
